tob-0039-d8: This roll holds part of the official Nuremberg record of the Doctors’ Trial — the 1946-47 trial of physicians for Nazi medical crimes. Witnesses speak and lawyers plead here word for word. The record is a landmark of world justice.
frus-1943-cairo-tehran-d8: Prime Minister Churchill to President Roosevelt, June 13, 1943 — Document 8. The third member of the Big Three joined the correspondence. The message is the triangle: Churchill, writing in.
